root_cause: Obligation Terminal Closure decided whether to wait for production readback partly from Delivery-Lane. Backend control-plane changes therefore waited for a Production Release Readback that canonical production workflows intentionally never trigger for ignored control-plane paths.
prevention_rule: Terminal production evidence applicability must be derived from the same ignored-path contract used by Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback. Pure ignored-path changes close on protected-main containment; any production-bearing path remains fail-closed on provider/readback proof.

evidence.observed: Delivery Pattern Memory v1 was a pure control-plane change and canonical production workflows ignored it, while terminal closure still entered production readback wait.
